Los Angeles, California · stay

Hotels in Los Angeles for cyclists

Places to stay in Los Angeles when you are in town to ride. Picked for being near the riding, easy with a bike, or cheap. Book early for event weekends. Rooms go first.

Hotels in Los Angeles for cyclists, listed

1 with a bike policy in writing · 5 to ask. A hotel's bike rule counts here only when it's on the hotel's own page.

  1. HI Los Angeles Santa Monica Hostel

    $ · 1436 2nd Street, Santa Monica, CA 90401

    Downtown Santa Monica, 0.4 mile from the pier by its own page; the beach path passes the pier. The one place this run found with the bike policy in writing. Beds from $35 (HI's site, Sept 2026); dorms of 4 to 10 and private rooms; elevator, kitchen, lockers; check-in 3, out 11. No parking: the P6 structure across the street is $20 to $25 a day, Civic Center $5 to $14 and a 10-minute walk.

    Bike: Free bicycle storage at the hostel (its words). E-bikes only if UL- or EN 15194-certified; nothing charges inside the building.

  2. Inn at Venice Beach

    327 Washington Boulevard, Venice, CA 90292

    Washington Blvd in Venice, two blocks from the sand by its own page. The beach path runs on-street along Washington here, so you roll out the door onto it. Nothing about your own bike on the inn's page; the chain page says Pacifica Hotels "invites you (and your bike)" and rents bikes. No rate shown (Sept 2026).

    Bike: No stated policy — ask when you book

    Book · innatvenicebeach.com

  3. The Ambrose Hotel

    1255 20th Street, Santa Monica, CA 90404

    Mid-city Santa Monica on 20th St, the nearest hotel this run found to 26th and San Vicente, where Velo Club La Grange's weekday rides (Tue, Wed, Thu and Fri, 6:30 am) leave. Beach cruisers to borrow "based on availability," per the page; nothing about your own bike. No rate shown (Sept 2026).

    Bike: No stated policy — ask when you book

    Book · ambrosehotel.com

  4. Kimpton Hotel Palomar Los Angeles Beverly Hills

    10740 Wilshire Boulevard, Los Angeles, CA 90024

    Wilshire Blvd in Westwood, the same ZIP as Raymond Fouquet Square, the start of La Grange's Nichols Canyon ride (Sundays, 8:00 am). No bike line on the page. No rate shown; self-parking $55 a day, valet $77 (Sept 2026).

    Bike: No stated policy — ask when you book

  5. Kimpton Everly Hotel

    1800 Argyle Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90028

    Hollywood, below the hills; Griffith Park is the near end of a ride from here. No bike line on the page. No rate shown; valet parking $75 plus tax a night (Sept 2026).

    Bike: No stated policy — ask when you book

  6. Sea Sprite Beach Club

    $$$ · 1016 The Strand, Hermosa Beach, CA 90254

    On the Strand in Hermosa Beach; the Strand is the beach path here, and the page says "direct access to The Strand's 22-mile oceanfront path." South, the path leaves the sand at First Ave for the roll to Redondo Pier and the start of the Donut Ride (Saturdays, 8:00 am). The page's only bike line is about rentals. Starting rate $287 (Sept 2026), after a 2025 remodel.

    Bike: No stated policy — ask when you book

    Book · seaspritebeachclub.com
